routes.reason: A new roadmap is justified. No layer plans admissible pairs or p-adic Hodge structures in families, their moduli for non-reductive groups, Hodge and Hodge–Tate loci, or p-adic functional transcendence. HS2 treats local shtukas of reductive groups for Fargues–Scholze; PadicHodgeTheory treats period rings and comparisons; LD.6 and the Mok–Pila–Tsimerman proposal treat o-minimal transcendence. The review added seven items and a corrections paragraph to the brief (smoothness, descent, families, MG connectedness, §7.5, the §9 lemmas).

Stabilizers of lines, observable subgroups and Levi decompositions of non-reductive groups are general facts that Tau Ceti's ReductiveGroups does not state, so a Part II there is right. The review added the vector-group structure of commutative unipotent groups and Steinberg's theorem over Q̆_p.

Classical points, irreducible components, weakly Shilov points, resolution and constant rank for rigid analytic varieties extend AdicSpacesPartII, which stops at coherent sheaves; R09.7 resolves only varieties. Right owner.
Scholze–Weinstein 10.2.3 belongs in D6. The review moved item 024 (the D ×_{|Y|} Y construction, which no stage plans) here as missing, and added products of a diamond with a profinite set.
Scholze's functor M and the B_dR^+-local system comparisons belong in P8.
B(G, [μ]) and its basic element belong in BG1. The review added Fargues–Scholze III.4.5 (basic strata for reductive G) as planned at BG3.
The non-emptiness criterion and the connectedness of admissible loci are properties of HS2's moduli.
Klingler–Ullmo–Yafaev's hyperbolic Ax–Lindemann is an LD.6 input, as the extraction says.

notes: Reviewed against arXiv v2 (the extraction's version; SHA-256 c133b06b…) and its TeX, with the Part I TeX for the Part I inputs, by five checkers. The published version (Invent. Math. 244 (2026)) could not be read: Springer's PDF redirects to the paywalled article page, and the authors' SharedIt link returns no text. Corrections were made in place: 39 statements, 45 locators and 4 statuses (024 planned → missing; 023, 076 and 079 re-pointed). There are 11 new items (2 planned, 9 missing). E1–E14 are confirmed; E14's correction is too strong (v1's Lemma 4.1.1 also holds when the twisted unipotent group has slopes ≥ 0). E15–E48 are new. Among them are 20 misprints and nine gaps in the proof, each with a verified repair: smoothness hypotheses used for singular S (Lemmas 6.3.3, 7.4.4), a descent step in Theorem 3.3.1(3), the family argument for HS°(Y), a missing weight step in Proposition 6.4.1 (commented out in the TeX), MG connectedness, Lemma 9.3.1 used for irreducible Z, Part I Corollary 5.5.3 over non-strict fields, and Lemma 9.3.5's residue field. There are four errors: Lemma 7.5.1 fails for disconnected Y, Remark 7.5.3's preimage claim is false, the proof of Proposition 7.5.2 misidentifies Hdg(ℓ) when H^1(Q_p, H) → H^1(Q_p, G) has a kernel (SL_2 ⊃ anisotropic torus), and Lemma 9.3.3's 'if' direction fails beyond points. Theorems A, B and 9.1.3 stand.
